name: ATC_OFFER_RECOMMEND_RULES
description: Stores details of product offer recommendation rules

columns.name: OFFER_RECOMMEND_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique row id

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the  type of the subjectProduct used in the rule like SPEC,OFFER etc.

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: EARLY_TERM_PENALTY
columns.description: The amount, in currency, to charge if the customer terminates the promotion before the specified end date.

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: COMMITMENT_START_CODE
columns.description: For Original Start, Starts on the date of the original promotion. For Now, Starts today. For Original End, Starts on the end date of the original promotion.

columns.name: DURATION_CODE
columns.description: For Original Duration, Uses the duration fields that are defined for the original promotion, that is, the promotion from which it is upgraded. For New Duration, Uses the duration fields that are defined for the new promotion, that is, the promotion to which it is upgraded.

columns.name: OFFER_RECOMMEND_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Identifier of the recommendation rule

columns.name: SUBJECT_PRODUCT
columns.description: Subject offer component of the recommendation rule

columns.name: OBJECT_PRODUCT
columns.description: Object offer component of the recommendation rule

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating if this recommendation Rule is active or not

columns.name: REASON
columns.description: The message is used by customer service representatives to tell customers the reason that they should purchase the upsell or cross-sell product.

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start time from which the rule is valid

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End Time to which the rule is valid

columns.name: RULE_SCORE
columns.description: Indicates rule score

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates message type

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the entity to which the rule is associated to

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the entity name to which the rule is associated to

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
